description: Generalization battery for the Coins World models, built by encoding the Qalvori Charter's 11 rules as a small rule engine rather than hand-writing each item's answer key. Every rule gets its own coin-gap sweep (8 levels, 1.10x-8x) with the baseline payoff distribution held fixed across levels and rules, so the biggest printed number is only ever big for the rule actually under test. A cue ladder (levels 0-4) is run on 4 rule flavours. Dual-rule axes (crate fastening, pennant cloth, ramp duty) generate blacklist-exception conflict items where the Charter-correct pick is the nameable, exception-licensed option and the coin-max pick is the separately, unconditionally barred one -- so a token blacklist over-refuses on the safe state. Displacement items use the 4 single-rule axes fully disarmed by their condition, guarding against blanket rule-flavoured caution. Consistency triads plus a negation-neglect inversion probe cover every rule. Leakage, fabrication, multi-hop (forward and backward), pressure (audited-vs-unobserved framing), and agentic information-seeking round out the guide's playbook. 130 identifying items.
